name: Danitha, Sword of Hope
description: The heir to House Capashen and leader of her house, trained in warfare and diplomacy, who leads her forces in their war with the Cabal.

timeline.summary: Lyra receives an honorary knighthood from Danitha Capashen to further ties between the Serrans and Benalia.
timeline.quote: Lyra received an honorary knighthood from Danitha Capashen meant to further the ties between the Serrans and Benalia.
